run_mpc_cifar_training: run the MPC CIFAR10 training loop with LeNet for a specified number of epochs
validate_model: validate a plaintext or encrypted LeNet model on a CIFAR10 validation dataset
construct_private_model: construct an encrypted private model from a trained PyTorch LeNet for multi-party computation
encrypt_data_tensor: encrypt a data tensor with a specified source rank for secure multi-party inference
create_lenet_model: create a LeNet convolutional neural network with ReLU activations for CIFAR10 classification
